2. अच्छ m. (corruption of ऋक्ष), a bear.

3. अ॑च्छ (so at the end of a pāda), or usually अ॑च्छा ind., Ved. to, towards (governing acc. and rarely the locative). It is a kind of separable preposition or prefix to verbs and verbal derivatives, as in the following.
